tools.name: analyze_barcode
tools.description: Validate and analyze a single EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13, or GTIN-14 barcode. Checks the GTIN check digit, detects common missing check digits, preserves leading zeros, safely removes spaces and hyphens, and returns GTIN-14 normalization when possible. Price: $0.001 USDC per call.

tools.name: analyze_barcode_batch
tools.description: Validate and analyze up to 100,000 EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13, or GTIN-14 barcodes in one request. Supports full results, errors-only results, aggregate summaries, duplicate detection, optional deduplication, selective filtering by validity, barcode type, and validation error type, and configurable result
